plan.notes: TRUE DEGREE NAME: 'Computer Science, A.S.' (program code 5CS), General Sequence — verified on TC3's official program page and catalog; not substituted. TC3 also publishes a separate 'Computer Science, A.S. - Engineering Sequence' (5CS-E) variant; this plan is the General Sequence only. Source: TC3 official online catalog (Coursedog) degree map 'Computer Science, A.S. - General Sequence': https://tompkinscortland.catalog.prod.coursedog.com/programs/onVJFq54HHPUZkeBWd9L ; program page: https://www.tompkinscortland.edu/programs/computer-science (states 'Computer Science A.S.' and 'To Graduate 59-65 credits + 2.0 GPA or higher'). Catalog year 2025-2026 (catalog Academic Calendar AY 2025-2026; catalog PDF generated 2026-01-23). Transcription method: term-by-term structure (5 terms: Year 0 Pre- or Co-Requisite Courses, Year 1 Fall, Year 1 Spring, Year 2 Fall, Year 2 Spring) extracted verbatim from the catalog's own degree-map data; course codes, titles, credits, and minimum grades cross-checked against the official catalog PDF rendering of the same degree map. CREDIT RANGE: the catalog publishes 59-65 credits to graduate; the sequence sums to 59-65 depending on GE choice credits (SUNY GE 4-way humanities/history/language choice = 1-3 cr; SUNY GE #4 Natural Sciences lab = 3-4 cr). This plan is modeled at the 59-credit MINIMUM path (choice slots set to catalog minimums: 4-way=1, GE#4 lab=3) so the pipeline's exact-sum check passes; the maximum path totals 65. Catalog minimum grade of C required on ENGL100, MATH138, and MATH201. Year-0 developmental courses (ENGL098, RDNG116, MATH120, MATH020) are 0-credit, required only by placement, flagged required_zero. Per-course prerequisites are not published in the degree map; prereq lists are left empty rather than invented. SUNY GE bucket labels carry the catalog's 'Fall 2024' list version as printed.
